text: {"lessons":["I will define in advance what would make me buy or sell each stock, rather than reacting to recent price moves; my repeated trades in A, B, and E did not produce a consistent plan.","I will check whether a new purchase still fits my thesis and risk limits, especially after a sharp rise; buying more at higher prices and later selling at a loss can compound poor timing.","I will review the whole portfolio before trading, including cash needs and exposure to each stock, so that individual decisions do not leave me overcommitted or driven by short-term fluctuations."]}
